explanation: The firm hope of things we wait for; the awareness of the reality of things we do not see.
The sure expectation of future promises from God that have not yet been fulfilled.
God's unchangeable pledge to humanity regarding salvation, inheritance, and blessing.
A state of being in right relationship with God through faith in His word.
The visible creation that is subject to decay and not eternal when compared with God's kingdom.
The coming life or the new world that believers await after death.
